title.original: The Granularity Mismatch in Agent Security: Argument-Level Provenance Solves Enforcement and Isolates the LLM Reasoning Bottleneck
title.zh: 智能体安全中的粒度失配：参数级来源追踪实现策略执行并隔离 LLM 推理瓶颈
title.en: The Granularity Mismatch in Agent Security: Argument-Level Provenance Solves Enforcement and Isolates the LLM Reasoning Bottleneck

inclusion_reason.zh: PACT 的参数角色、跨步 provenance 图和 Capability Contract 检查器是可部署的混合可信工具调用参考监视器。
inclusion_reason.en: PACT's argument roles, cross-step provenance graph, and capability-contract checks form a deployable reference monitor for mixed-trust tool calls.

abstract.zh: PACT（Provenance-Aware Capability Contracts）在工具参数级追踪来源并按语义角色授权，避免把混合可信调用整体放行或隔离。
abstract.en: PACT (Provenance-Aware Capability Contracts) tracks provenance at tool-argument granularity and authorizes by semantic role, avoiding all-or-nothing treatment of mixed-trust calls.

problem.zh: 调用级信任无法区分“外部内容用于检索对象”和“外部内容决定高权限目标/命令”，因而在安全与正常工作流之间被迫二选一。
problem.en: Invocation-level trust cannot distinguish external data used as benign content from external data controlling an authority-bearing destination or command.

approach.zh: 运行时给每个参数标注语义角色，跨重新规划追踪值来源，并检查该来源是否满足角色特定 Capability Contract。
approach.en: The runtime labels each argument's semantic role, tracks value provenance across replanning, and checks origins against role-specific capability contracts.

system_design.zh: 监视器位于 Agent 与工具之间，由参数角色分析、跨步 provenance 图、契约检查器和调用门组成，逐参数形成允许/拒绝决定。
system_design.en: A monitor between agent and tools combines argument-role analysis, a cross-step provenance graph, contract checks, and a call gate to decide per argument.

key_results.zh: Oracle provenance 下该粒度同时保持安全与效用；真实 AgentDojo 部署中也在强模型上保持安全并比调用级方案恢复更多正常任务。
key_results.en: With oracle provenance, argument-level control preserves both security and utility; in AgentDojo it maintains security on stronger models while recovering more benign work than invocation-level controls.

limitations.zh: 部署效果取决于 provenance 推断和契约合成准确性；摘要显示安全可达但效用恢复仍有限，隐式数据流也可能逃逸追踪。
limitations.en: Deployment depends on accurate provenance inference and contract synthesis; utility recovery remains limited even at strong security, and implicit flows may evade tracking.
